title: The (Unofficial) MCVerse.city Railway resource pack
description: This project adds many railway themed blocks, sounds and textures
body:
Heey welcome to the Unofficial MCVerse Railway Resource pack page!!!

this resource pack changes many blocks and sounds to make the railways feel more alive and immersive with such blocks as 3d rickety rail that replaces ALL the rail, Railway Buffers and stone crossings!

this resource pack works with the vanilla launcher!

comes complete with Railway station ambience and 3 different 'incoming train' sounds voiced by Glados (our friendly neighbourhood robot... right?)

Below is a list of all the changed blocks (minus the rail list) and sounds!


Blocks

Light Grey Glazed Terracotta   > Stone Crossing!
Yellow Glazed Terracotta       > Yellow/Grey Platform Coping
Dark Oak Shelf                 > Railway Buffer

Disks

Disk 11      > Train station ambience


NoteBlocks

Cow_bell       > incoming 1
didgeridoo     > incoming 2
pling          > incoming 3 


i hope you enjoy this resource pack... especially those over at MCVerse.city! :)
